name: Check a translated interface still makes sense
why: Reviews translated app screens string by string for lost meaning, broken placeholders and cut-off text, the same checks as the UI strings prompt.

name: Make a voiceover and ship it in other languages
why: Takes a script to a voiceover, dubbed versions and subtitles; pair it with the voiceover adaptation prompt so the translated script fits the timing first.

name: Video caption maker in your brand font
why: Builds timed caption groups and a subtitle file for video ads, useful after the captions-and-subtitles skill has the text right.

name: Shopify Markets setup planner
why: Plans market groups, currencies and languages for a Shopify shop going abroad, the set-up step before translations go live.

name: Plain English editor
why: Cleans up English source text before translation; clearer source gives cleaner machine and human translations.

name: Multi-language site planner
why: Plans language URLs, hreflang, translation steps, currencies and right-to-left layouts, matching the new market website launch workflow.

name: Overseas listing localizer
why: Adapts product listings for other countries with local language, sizes and label reminders; run the locale format check on its output.

name: Check translation parity across three languages
why: Finds changed numbers, names, terms and quotes between language versions, a useful second check on long documents.

name: App translation setup helper
why: Finds hardcoded text and sets up locale files and right-to-left support, the groundwork that makes app translation possible.

name: Customer support message translator
why: Translates incoming customer messages and drafts replies in the customer's language; use it with the business's glossary for consistent terms.
